title: Global Regularity of Solutions to the Inviscid Surface Quasi-Geostrophic Equation
exact_target: Can a smooth inviscid SQG flow form a singularity in finite time, or must every allowed smooth initial state remain smooth forever?

sources.citation: Cordoba, Martinez-Zoroa, and Ozanski, Instantaneous Continuous Loss of Regularity for the SQG Equation, Introduction.
